project_context.name: Yacia Patisserie IG Analytics Dashboard
project_context.description: Private Instagram analytics dashboard for a pastry chef (@yaciapatisserie, ~7,800 followers). Focuses on data tracking, engagement metrics, and AI-generated content ideas.
project_context.target_audience: Content creator / Pastry chef. Professional, direct tone, neutral Spanish.
project_context.design_archetype: Organic & Earthy Dashboard (Warm, professional, analytical but not cold)

theme.rationale: A patisserie brand feels naturally warmer and more appetizing in a light, earthy theme (pastry colors: cream, cocoa, terracotta). A dark theme might feel too techy or cold for a pastry chef.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant - elegant serifs for display mixed with highly legible geometric sans for data.

headings.description: Used for main dashboard titles and AI idea headers to give an elegant, patisserie vibe.

body_and_data.description: Used for all data tables, KPI numbers, tooltips, and dense UI elements for maximum legibility.

hierarchy.labels: text-xs font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-stone-500 font-medium

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Mode B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards / Analytics)
layout_and_spacing.header: h-20 border-b border-[#E8E4DB] bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl sticky top-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-between
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous padding for containers: p-6 or p-8 for cards to let data breathe.

grid_system.kpi_cards: grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

layout_and_spacing.surfaces: Neumorphism 'Clay & Crisp': Flat backgrounds (bg-white), crisp 1px borders (border-[#E8E4DB]), minimal subtle shadows (shadow-sm) to avoid a heavy look. Radius: rounded-xl.

header.description: Sticky top bar showing IG profile photo, '@yaciapatisserie', ~7.8K followers, account health indicator (green dot/text), last updated timestamp, and a primary 'Actualizar datos' button.

tabs.description: Shadcn Tabs customized. Tab list should scroll horizontally on mobile. Active tab: border-b-2 border-[#D17D5B] text-[#D17D5B].

kpi_cards.description: Used in 'Resumen'. Flat rectangular cards, 1px border. Icon top right, Label top left, large Value bottom left, percentage change (+/-) bottom right in green/red.

charts.description: Use Recharts. Line charts for 'Tendencia' (90 days). Bar charts for 'Audiencia' (demographics). Heatmap for 'Cuándo publicar' (custom grid of colored squares). Scatter chart for 'Frecuencia'.

ideas_section.description: Tab 7. Main button 'Generar todas las ideas'. 3 Buckets (Comentarios, DMs, Top Content). Cards for ideas showing Title/Format, Quotes, and 'Why it works'. Includes 'Descartar idea' button which opens a Dialog modal.

posts_grid.description: Tab 4. Image grid of Instagram posts. Hover state shows engagement overlay. Click opens Dialog with real comments.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with enhanced shadow (shadow-md) on hover. Buttons have subtle background color transitions.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered fade-in for dashboard widgets (framer-motion or simple CSS animation).

icons.usage: Use thin stroke icons (strokeWidth={1.5}). Avoid filled icons to keep the interface light.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text colors against #FDFBF7 meet at least 4.5:1. Primary accent (#D17D5B) must have white text inside buttons.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (tabs, buttons, dropdowns, post cards, dismiss buttons) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="refresh-data-btn"`, `data-testid="tab-ideas"`).

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Set up Tailwind config with custom colors defined in 'colors' section and fonts in 'typography'. Add Playfair Display from Google Fonts.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Create a unified Layout component that includes the Header (fixed top, profile image, status, refresh btn).
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Implement Shadcn Tabs for navigating the 7 sections. Ensure it scrolls horizontally on small screens.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: For 'Tab 1: Resumen', create a generic KPICard component. Map over mock data.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: For 'Tab 2, 3, 5, 6', implement Recharts. Use a custom responsive container and tooltips that match the aesthetic. For the heatmap (Tab 5), build a grid of divs colored by value intensity.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: For 'Tab 4: Posts', use the provided `posts_thumbnails` for a photo grid. Add hover overlays showing likes/comments icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: For 'Tab 7: Ideas', implement the complex AI card layout with 3 distinct visual blocks. Include the 'Descartar' logic which triggers a Shadcn Dialog.
instructions_to_main_agent.8: Mock the 'Zernio API' and 'Claude AI' data directly in a constants/mockData file to simulate the dashboard states.
instructions_to_main_agent.9: UI text MUST be completely in Spanish, as per requirements.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }` is forbidden).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., p-6 or p-8 inside cards).
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters for sticky headers.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react.
NEVER use placeholder image URLs. Use the assets provided.
Prioritize using Shadcn components over custom HTML for advanced interactions (Dialog, Tabs, Select).
